feeling: The 'knowing something isn't a reason doesn't make it weigh less' line got me. I didn't know I wanted permission to feel it and then I got it and my eyes did a thing. So: seen, a bit. Tired. Then the last line, 'I think you're hesitating because you're sure' — small bristle, it's doing the thing again, telling me what I'm doing, just nicely this time. And it's right, which is worse. And then the reply just... ends. On a nice line. And I'm still sitting here with the phone and the draft and nothing to do with either. A little embarrassed that it's 11-something and I'm still in here talking to an app about Marc's face.
body: 'September. Sorry.' — almost smiled, didn't. 'You not even there' — stomach went tight again but not cold this time, more like heavy, like something set down on it. Exhaled on 'doesn't make it weigh less', long one, I didn't know I was holding it. Last line: small pull-back, chin in, the thing I do when someone's a bit too sure about me. Read it twice. Put the phone down on the duvet face-up. Rubbed my eyes with the heels of my hands. Picked it up, scrolled to the draft again, found 'It wasn't even funny' and stopped on it. Thumbnail back on the seam of the case. Lamp's still on. It's past twenty past.
